scenario.name: Dashboard with charts + sidebar + login
scenario.prompt: Build a dashboard web app that shows analytics with charts and a sidebar navigation, with a login screen.

plan.title: Build a minimal analytics dashboard app
plan.summary: Create a locally runnable multi-page dashboard with login, sidebar navigation, analytics cards, and charts using the existing project files.
steps: Inspect the existing index.html and app.js to identify the current app structure, available dependencies, and runnable setup.
Implement the login screen with email and password fields, basic validation, and a local demo login flow that transitions to the dashboard.
Add the dashboard shell with a persistent sidebar, responsive layout, navigation routes, and active page states.
Build the analytics overview page with summary metric cards and at least two interactive charts using an available local charting approach.
Add supporting dashboard pages such as reports, customers, and settings with consistent minimal styling and navigation.
Wire client-side routing, logout behavior, responsive behavior, and empty or loading states as appropriate.
Run the app locally and verify login, navigation, chart rendering, responsive layout, and refresh behavior in the browser.
risks: The existing project dependencies and styling conventions are not yet verified.
A charting library may not be installed, requiring a lightweight local implementation or dependency addition.
Login will be a local demonstration flow unless backend authentication is added separately.
